title: kabul chana salad
howToPrepare:
Ingredients:

        Boiled kabul chana

        Tomatoes

        onion

        green chilli 

        bell pepper

        cucumber

        olives

        lemon juice

        coreander leaves

        How to prepare:

        In a bowl add boiled kabul chana, bell pepper, cucumber, onion, tomato, green chilli,
        olives and lemon juice and mix well and serve if you like to add some sour cream we can add 
        sour cream too.
